zh: 冬天已然沾上遠遊的心情
自積雪的山坡漫延而來
參揉着夢境離去的漠落
en: Winter has already taken on the mood of far travel
This village of gravel and mud
There is a strange kind of quiet
Spreading down from the snow-covered slope
Mingled with the indifference of a departing dream
By the bleak roadside
Between harbor and headland

zh: 河灣遠處閃著微弱的波光
竟有一種錯過期約的悵然
en: Far off at the river bend, a faint glimmer of ripples
Fine rain within the Arctic Circle
Wanting to say it, yet holding back
Drifting into traces of snow on the mountainside
Dyed into a hazy ink-wash pattern
Thoughts stirred up
Like faded, yellow-gray letter paper
Swaying in the faint morning light
Strange yet familiar
There is, unexpectedly, the melancholy of a missed appointment
The wild grass at the fjord's edge withered yellow
Damp and cold
Receding slowly toward the foot of the mountain
Following the gentle mountain breeze
Tracing back up from the valley floor
Perhaps
The traces the years have left
A drifting state of mind

zh: 冬天初始降臨的偏遠村落
en: Right when the clouds hang thick
Cold rain begins to rise
The remote village where winter first arrives
I remember, stricken with grief
You, far away, have already
No word for a long while

points.zh: Svalbard位於挪威北部，北極圈内的一組群島，Spitsbergen是其中最大的島。該島最北端跨入北緯80度。Longyearbyen是Spitsbergen島的最大聚落，居民只有二千人，却是全世界最北端的最大聚落，是Svalbard北極圈遊輪的主要出入港灣。
points.en: Svalbard is a group of islands north of Norway, within the Arctic Circle. Spitsbergen is the largest of these islands, its northernmost point crossing into 80 degrees north latitude. Longyearbyen is the largest settlement on Spitsbergen, with a population of only two thousand, yet it is the largest settlement at the northernmost point in the world, and serves as the main port of embarkation and disembarkation for Arctic cruises to Svalbard.
